definitions.explanation: A structure built along a coast or harbor to protect against waves and storm surges.
Something that serves as a protective barrier against threats or harmful influences.

examples.japanese: {防波堤|ぼうはてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{防波堤|ぼうはてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: The seawall was damaged by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{防波堤|ぼうはてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{築|きず}かれた→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: A large breakwater was built to protect the harbor.

examples.english: Community bonds are the greatest bulwark against disasters.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧ (protect against), {波|は} (waves), and {堤|てい} (embankment; levee). In Japan, breakwaters are a common sight at harbors and along the coast, often used as popular fishing spots. The figurative sense is frequently used in news and editorials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防波堤|ぼうはてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fish from a breakwater
- {防波堤|ぼうはてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧: to build a seawall
- {防波堤|ぼうはてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決壊|けっかい}→決壊：15288_kekkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the breakwater collapses
- {防波堤|ぼうはてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす→役割を果たす：19503_yakuwariwohatasu⟧: to serve as a bulwark

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧: levee; embankment — built along rivers to prevent flooding, while {防波堤|ぼうはてい} is for ocean waves
- {護岸|ごがん}: revetment; shore protection — reinforcement of riverbanks or coastlines
- {防潮堤|ぼうちょうてい}: tidal barrier; storm surge wall — specifically designed against tidal surges and tsunamis
